method: English words per Chinese character, tables and code fences excluded. Calibrated to the field: 0.784 words/char measured across the 41 scored packages (see score_correlates.json); the floor is 0.75 of that. This measures content parity, which string-coverage counters do not. Parity does not predict review score (r = -0.20); the gate exists for the reader.
